inspection_advice: Test wipers at all speeds and check for smooth operation.

label: Scuttle panel drain channels block causing water ingress
symptom: Water accumulates in the scuttle panel area, leading to component corrosion and potential interior leaks.
cause: Blockage of drain channels by leaves and debris.
fix: Regularly clean scuttle panel drains to prevent water buildup.
inspection_advice: Check scuttle area under windshield for debris and ensure drains are clear.
notes: Can lead to water ingress into interior and electrical issues. Often related to interior water leak.

label: Rear wheel bearing wear
symptom: Rear wheel bearings wear out, creating a rumbling noise like roller skates on concrete.
cause: Normal wear or contamination leading to bearing failure.
fix: Replace the affected wheel bearing assembly.
warning_signs: Rumbling or humming noise from rear
inspection_advice: Lift rear and spin wheels by hand to feel for roughness or listen for noise.
notes: A common wear item on higher mileage cars.

label: Water ingress in boot/trunk
symptom: Water leaks into the boot, often due to degraded rubber bungs.
cause: Degraded or missing rubber seals/bungs around boot lid or rear lights.
fix: Inspect and replace damaged rubber seals or bungs.
warning_signs: Water pooling in spare wheel well
inspection_advice: Check boot carpet and spare wheel well for moisture or signs of rust.
notes: Common in older examples; can promote rust.

label: Water ingress in boot and interior from degraded seals
symptom: Water leaks into the boot or interior carpets, often due to degraded seals or blocked drains.
cause: Degraded or missing rubber seals/bungs around boot lid, rear lights, or doors; blocked scuttle drains.
fix: Inspect and replace damaged rubber seals or bungs; clear scuttle drains.
warning_signs: Damp carpet in boot or footwells
Water pooling in spare wheel well
inspection_advice: Check boot carpet, spare wheel well, and interior footwells for moisture. Inspect door and boot seals for integrity.
notes: Common in older examples; can promote rust. Boot and interior leaks are related sealing issues.

warning_signs: Rumbling or humming noise from rear

label: EGR valve sooting and DPF clogging on diesel
symptom: Reduced engine performance, warning lights, or rough running due to EGR valve clogging with soot or DPF clogging from short trips.
cause: Soot accumulation in EGR valve; insufficient exhaust temperature for DPF regeneration.
fix: Clean or replace EGR valve; forced regeneration or DPF replacement.
inspection_advice: Check for EGR valve fault codes and soot buildup; check DPF condition and regeneration history.
notes: EGR and DPF issues are related chronic failures on the diesel engine.

label: EGR and DPF clogging on diesel engines
symptom: Reduced engine performance, warning lights, rough running, or frequent regeneration cycles due to soot accumulation in EGR valve and DPF clogging from short trips.
cause: Soot accumulation in EGR valve; insufficient exhaust temperature for DPF regeneration.
fix: Clean or replace EGR valve; forced regeneration or DPF replacement.
inspection_advice: Check for EGR valve fault codes and soot buildup; check DPF condition and regeneration history.
notes: Combined EGR and DPF issues common in diesel engines with short-trip usage.

label: Sat nav remote dependency and non-standard AUX input
symptom: Integrated TomTom sat nav unusable without proprietary remote; uncommon left/right dual-input aux port instead of standard 3.5mm jack.
cause: Design dependency on proprietary remote; design choice for audio input.
fix: Replace remote batteries or use alternative navigation; use adapter cable.
inspection_advice: Check sat nav remote functionality; check audio input ports.
notes: Combined sat nav and AUX input issues from same source.
